text: Welcome back to Meridian Health Network. Technical Architecture's capstone decided what this organization's ServiceNow platform should look like. This chapter starts a different job: taking that approved architecture and actually implementing one real, working capability with it.

A quick recap. Meridian is the new parent company over three hospital systems: St. Catherine's Medical Center at 2,200 employees with the most mature IT function, Lakeshore Regional Health at 1,600 employees with a strong local-autonomy culture, and Prairie View Health Partners at 1,200 employees, still wary after a forced consolidation eight years ago. Technical Architecture already decided one instance, with Domain Separation across three subordinate domains. That decision is final, and this chapter does not revisit it.

Here's what actually exists today. St. Catherine's runs a formal ticketing process with detailed multi-tier categories and a change board. Lakeshore runs something lighter, built locally over the years, with real pride of ownership in it. Prairie View runs the most informal process of the three — a shared inbox and a tracking sheet. None of the three talks to the others. That gap is exactly what Lesson 13's stakeholder interviews need to surface in real detail.

Rather than attempt everything Meridian's board eventually wants at once, this capstone scopes one concrete workstream: a unified IT Service Desk — incident management, request management, and one shared catalog front door — for all three systems, inside the domain structure that's already decided. Three reasons make this the right first move, not just the smallest one. It carries none of HR's or facilities' HIPAA-adjacent risk, so mistakes here stay cheap. Every employee at all three systems eventually touches it, so a working rollout is a visible, trust-building early win. And it's the first real test of whether those domain boundaries — the ones that looked clean on a diagram in Technical Architecture — actually hold up once real agents at three different hospital systems start using them every day.
That's the workstream and the reasoning behind it. Next, Lesson 13 puts you in front of all three systems' current help-desk leads — and their requirements don't fully agree.
